paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.53 as of September 9, 2026, with a decrease of 3.15% from the prior close and 5.95% over the last 22 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes an investment of $12.01 million in Fermi Inc. by Whetstone Capital Advisors LLC, as reported by MarketBeat on September 10, 2026. This investment was disclosed in the company's most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, with recent filings including a Form 3 on September 3, 2026, and multiple Form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18, 2026. An 8-K filing on August 31, 2026, announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders for October 30, 2026.
